basis: Computed live from the database. In the demo this is synthetic data; mock-provider assessments are listed separately.

latency_ms.note: per provider in by_provider; free-tier rate-limit waits inflate real-provider latency

definitions.scope: Requests whose submitted_at falls in [since, until]; assessments, decisions and findings are those of these requests.
definitions.latest_assessment: For status and risk distributions only the newest assessment version of each request is counted.
definitions.processing_time: Hours from the request's creation (audit log entry request.created) to its first approve/reject decision, so documents carrying older business dates do not distort it.
definitions.ai_agreement: Among final decisions (approve/reject) with a clear AI signal: agreed = approve when the AI found no issues or reject when it found issues. The AI never recommends approval; 'no issues found' is only the absence of findings.
definitions.finding_review_agreement: Share of reviewer verdicts on individual findings that are 'agree'.
definitions.vendor_spread: (highest - lowest) / lowest quotation total among quotations on one request in the request's currency; needs two or more. No exchange rates are used.
definitions.chosen_vs_lowest: Requests where a quotation from the requested supplier exists: was it the lowest, and by how much was it above the lowest when not?
